statement: Between 2026-08-26 and 2026-11-30, a Russian presidential decree ordering a new general or partial mobilization of citizens into the armed forces is published on the official legal portal publication.pravo.gov.ru.
resolution: TRUE if publication.pravo.gov.ru carries a presidential decree dated 2026-08-26 through 2026-11-30 ordering general or partial mobilization of citizens; routine conscription-campaign and reservist training-assembly decrees do not count.
failure_condition: No presidential decree ordering general or partial mobilization of citizens, with a date inside the window, appears on the official legal portal.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Nvidia (NVDA) official Nasdaq closing price on 2026-08-27, the session after its scheduled 2026-08-26 after-close earnings release, is more than 5.0 percent above or below its 2026-08-26 official close.
resolution: TRUE if the Nasdaq official closing price of NVDA on 2026-08-27 differs from the 2026-08-26 official close by more than 5.0 percent in either direction; a move of exactly 5.0 percent or less is FALSE.
failure_condition: The NVDA official close on 2026-08-27 is within 5.0 percent of the official close on 2026-08-26.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-08-25 and 2026-10-31, the HHS Office for Civil Rights breach portal posts an entry naming Nutex Health or a Nutex-affiliated hospital with 500 or more individuals affected.
resolution: TRUE if the HHS OCR breach portal lists an entry whose covered-entity name contains Nutex or names a hospital Nutex Health publicly identifies as its facility, with submission date 2026-08-25 through 2026-10-31 and 500 or more individuals affected.
failure_condition: No qualifying Nutex-linked entry with 500 or more individuals affected and a submission date inside the window appears on the HHS OCR breach portal.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-08-26 and 2026-10-31, CISA adds to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog at least one Zimbra Collaboration vulnerability other than CVE-2026-73570.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog JSON contains an entry whose vendorProject or product field includes Zimbra, with a dateAdded value 2026-08-26 through 2026-10-31, and a cveID other than CVE-2026-73570.
failure_condition: The KEV catalog contains no Zimbra entry other than CVE-2026-73570 with a dateAdded value inside the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: On at least one day between 2026-08-26 and 2026-10-15, the Singapore National Environment Agency 24-hour PSI for at least one of the five reporting regions reaches 101 or higher.
resolution: TRUE if NEA published 24-hour PSI data (data.gov.sg historical PSI or NEA haze page) shows a value of 101 or higher for any region on any day 2026-08-26 through 2026-10-15.
failure_condition: Every NEA 24-hour regional PSI reading for every day in the window is 100 or below.
